root.description: Table root: an absolute local filesystem path, or an s3:// / az:// / abfss:// URI. A relative path is refused -- this connector has no project directory to anchor one against.

storage_options.description: Passed verbatim to delta-rs's object_store backend (e.g. AWS_REGION, AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME). Values are secrets in effect; never echoed back in errors or logs.
